inferential_decision_procedure.procedure_title: Guardian Alpha V30 Two-Tier Inferential Decision Algorithm

treatment_of_separated_defensive_episode.phenomenon: Eligible causal defensive sessions do not form a contiguous time series; they arrive in disconnected clusters separated by risk-on bull market regimes.
treatment_of_separated_defensive_episode.autocovariance_rule: Autocovariance \gamma_j is estimated strictly across observations separated by j calendar trading days within the same active regime episode. Pairs separated by inactive risk-on intervals are treated as mutually independent (covariance = 0.0).

stationary_block_bootstrap_specification.null_centering_transformation: \tilde{d}_t = d_t - \bar{d} + \delta_{min} \quad (\text{shifts mean to exact hurdle under } H02)

decision_procedure_pseudocode: INPUT: Paired differences {d_t} for t where I_{def,t}^{causal} == 1; N_def = len(d_t)
STEP 1: Compute sample mean d_bar = mean(d_t)
STEP 2: Compute Newey-West HAC variance sigma_hac^2 with lag q = floor(4*(N_def/100)^(2/9))
STEP 3: Evaluate Directional Test: t_dir = d_bar / (sigma_hac / sqrt(N_def))
IF p_dir >= 0.05 THEN RETURN 'FAIL: NO_DIRECTIONAL_SUPERIORITY (D2 fails to reduce downside losses)'
STEP 4: Evaluate Economic Hurdle Test (HAC): t_hurdle = (d_bar - 0.0010) / (sigma_hac / sqrt(N_def))
STEP 5: Evaluate Economic Hurdle Test (Stationary Block Bootstrap):
Generate B=10,000 bootstrap resamples using geometric block length b = ceil(N_def^(1/3))
hurdle_verdict = 'FAIL_TO_REJECT_H02 (Alpha does not exceed 10-bps economic hurdle with dual confidence)'
inferential_decision_procedure.formal_governance_notice: The decision procedure is mathematically deterministic and closed. It cannot be altered during or after data collection.
